$comment: Teardown of one reference thumbnail, following references/teardown-prompt.md. Look at the image (Read tool), fill every field in English with concrete, measurable wording, save it as styles/<videoId>.json. layout, person, object, background, camera, lighting, palette and mood go into the image prompt (person: style only, never the reference's identity). text steers the code typography. The four analysis fields steer the concepts.

layout.grid: centred host, objects on a shallow arc at eye level, headline band across the bottom

zones.object: three tiles left and three right of the head at eye level

person.pose: chest up, facing the camera, hands clasped under the chin
person.crop: cut at the chest by the bottom edge

object.what: six rounded app tiles with simple glyphs
object.material: glossy plastic with soft inner light
object.lighting: lit by the same key as the host, warm glow around each tile
object.size: each tile about 15% of frame height

background.color: deep navy #0B1329 with warm orange bokeh
background.depth: strongly out of focus, slight vignette

text.size: cap height about 14% of frame height

camera.focus: host and tiles sharp, background soft

lighting.key: soft frontal key from upper camera-left, about 25 degrees above
lighting.rim: warm rim on hair and shoulders

example.why_it_works: The arc of tool icons promises everything in one video and the calm smile says it is easy.
example.evergreen_fit: yes, as long as every tile stands for one concrete step
example.borrow: an arc of 3D tiles, one per step of the video, around a smiling host
